Headline: #12 Roosevelt and #18 16th/18th Temporary Eastbound Reroute near Roosevelt/Wabash
ShortDescription: Eastbound #12 Roosevelt and #18 16th/18th buses are temporarily rerouted, due to street blockage near Roosevelt/Wabash.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Eastbound #12 Roosevelt and #18 16th/18th buses are temporarily rerouted, due to street blockage near Roosevelt/Wabash. 

EB #12 Roosevelt buses will operate via: Roosevelt, Wabash, 13th, Indiana and over normal route.

EB #18 16th/18th buses will operate via: Roosevelt, State, 11th, Wabash and over normal route.

Westbound buses are not affected.

Allow extra travel time.
